newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks little changed in quiet London trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks little changed in quiet London trade.

text.p: U.S. stocks were little changed in London on Monday in fairly featureless dealings, traders said.

"There's really not much of a story here this morning," said one. "It's very quiet. There are press reports that the (U.S.) economic cycle is flatter and that should help interest rate sensitive stocks."
But few deals were made this morning, he said.
Traders were expecting Wall Street to open steady to firmer, based on the modest strength in the futures market.
On Globex, the December S&P 500 futures contract was 0.35 points higher at 758.35 at 1134 GMT. The December 30-year Treasury bond futures contract was up 6/32 at 116-14/32.
U.S. leading economic indicators for the October are due for release at 1330 GMT and new home sales for October are due at 1500 GMT.
